purpose: Authoritative machine-readable source for verification-level terminology. All documentation must conform. Terms are NEVER interchangeable.

SPIKE_EXACT.definition: Spike outputs (binary spike trains) are exactly equal between two implementations or runs for all compared steps.

measured_evidence.claim: CPU reference vs Vulkan GPU LIF: spike trains identical across 9 parity test cases and 12-step plasticity trajectories.

NUMERICALLY_EQUIVALENT.definition: Floating-point state (e.g. membrane potentials, weights) agrees within documented tolerances, without requiring byte equality.

measured_evidence.claim: CPU vs Vulkan trajectory parity: max abs potential diff < 1e-4, max abs weight diff < 2e-8.

BIT_EXACT.definition: Serialized state bytes AND the SHA-256 state hash are identical between two runs from identical initial conditions and seeds.
applies_to: deterministic experiment replication (CPU path): identical final_state_hash across independent runs
ALife replay: population_hash match on verify
checkpoint continuation: uninterrupted run vs snapshot->restore->continue

measured_evidence.claim: CPU deterministic experiments replicate with identical 256-bit state hashes.
ALife canonical run replays bit-exact (population hash match).

forbidden_usage: Describing CPU/Vulkan floating-point agreement as 'bit-exact' — it is NUMERICALLY_EQUIVALENT + SPIKE_EXACT.
Describing deterministic CPU replay as NUMERICALLY_EQUIVALENT — it is BIT_EXACT.

workstation.description: Vulkan device + local GGUF model present

cloud_ci.description: No GPU device, no GGUF weights (model binaries gitignored)
